summary: Iteration 284 QA of the 4 new features (live inventory, intent sensitivity, bug-report push, lockout settings). Backend: 17/17 pytest assertions pass for inventory CRUD/CSV/401 + admin ai-security-settings GET/PUT validation/persistence + bug report submit. Python-direct regression confirmed _get_hot_threshold (7), _get_lockout_settings ((8,15) store & env default) and _search_inventory_context (returns Tacoma bullet for 'red Tacomas?', '' for unrelated) when called with the seeded items' owner. Frontend: /inventory list/search/status chips/Mark Sold-Mark Available/Add modal/delete-with-confirm all work when reached from Hub > Manage > Inventory; AI & Security section (pills 1-10 + max fails + lockout + Save + persistence after reload) verified working on a store with a valid organization_id. TWO blocking/serious defects found: (1) /admin/stores/69a0b7095fddcede09591668 (the real store) fails to load — GET /api/admin/hierarchy/store/{id} returns 500 (organization_id 'org_001' is not a valid ObjectId), so the new AI & Security UI is unreachable for that store; (2) inventory PUT/DELETE have no ownership scoping (BOLA) — another authenticated user can modify/delete any item by _id. Also /inventory spins forever with no auth redirect when opened unauthenticated. All test data cleaned (3 seeded vehicles intact, QA bug report deleted, store settings restored to 7/8/15).

critical.issue: 500 InvalidId — store 69a0b7095fddcede09591668 has organization_id 'org_001' (legacy string) and admin_hierarchy.py:181 wraps it in ObjectId() unguarded. Whole admin store-detail screen shows 'Account not found' + 'Failed to load store details' alert, blocking the NEW AI & Security UI for the only real store. Fix: validate/try-except ObjectId or match on string id.

No ownership/store scoping — user_id in path is ignored. Verified: user mjeast1985@gmail.com successfully marked SOLD and deleted an inventory item created by the super admin (both 200). Should be 403/404. Fix: apply _scope_query(user_id) to the update/delete filters.

minor.issue: Works (200) and push is best-effort, but _push_super_admins is awaited inline before responding (adds latency) and swallows per-user errors with bare `except: pass` — no '[Push]' log line was emitted, so push delivery/failure is unobservable. Suggest background task + warning-level logging.

Super admin scope is {} (all items across all stores/tenants). Acceptable for now but it means the seeded 3 vehicles have store_id=null and are therefore invisible to real store users (forestward@gmail.com store scope returns 0 items, and Jessi's _search_inventory_context returns '' for that store) — seed data should carry store_id 69a0b7095fddcede09591668 so the AI inventory answers actually work for store reps.

ui_bugs.issue: Opening /inventory while unauthenticated (or before auth store hydrates) shows an infinite spinner and never fires an API call — fetchItems early-returns on !user?._id without setLoading(false) and there is no redirect to /auth/login (other routes like /more do redirect).

New AI & Security section cannot be reached for the production store 69a0b7095fddcede09591668 because the page's hierarchy fetch 500s (see backend critical #1). Page shows generic 'Account not found' with no retry affordance.

issues: Vehicle name truncates ('2024 Toyota Tacoma TRD Off-Ro...') because price sits on the same row — consider wrapping to 2 lines
Delete confirmation uses the browser's native window.confirm on web instead of a styled modal (functional, but off-brand)

No data-testid attributes reach the web DOM on any tested screen (document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid]') = 0). Automation must rely on text selectors; consider dataSet={{ testid: ... }} on RN web for interactive elements like the trash button, which currently has no accessible name/role.

action_items: Guard ObjectId() in routers/admin_hierarchy.py get_store_hierarchy (and audit other places using store['organization_id']) so legacy string org ids like 'org_001' don't 500 — this currently blocks the whole admin store detail page including the new AI & Security section.
Scope inventory PUT and DELETE by _scope_query(user_id) — cross-user update/delete currently succeeds (BOLA).
Add auth guard + loading reset on /inventory so unauthenticated/pre-hydration load doesn't spin forever.
Backfill store_id on the 3 seeded inventory vehicles (currently null) so store reps and Jessi's inventory search can see them.
Move _push_super_admins to a background task and log push results instead of silently passing.
critical_code_review_comments: routers/inventory.py update/delete ignore the user_id path param → any authenticated user can mutate any item; must filter with the same scope query used by list_inventory.
routers/inventory.py list_inventory rebuilds the query when scope has $or (line 62) — duplicated logic that's easy to break; build with a single $and list instead.
routers/bug_reports.py _push_super_admins swallows all exceptions with `except: pass`; failures are undiagnosable.
app/inventory.tsx fetchItems returns before the finally-block semantics matter for the !user._id case — set loading false or gate the screen behind auth.

success_rate.backend: 94% (17/18 assertions; 1 security scoping test fails by design)
success_rate.frontend: 80% (inventory flows pass; admin AI & Security unverifiable on target store due to 500)

rca_of_the_issue: Store detail 500: stores.organization_id for the real store is the legacy string 'org_001'; admin_hierarchy.get_store_hierarchy line 181 calls ObjectId(store['organization_id']) without validation → bson.errors.InvalidId → 500 → frontend renders 'Account not found', hiding the new AI & Security section. Inventory BOLA: update_inventory_item/delete_inventory_item filter only on {_id: ObjectId(item_id)}, ignoring the user_id path segment, so any authenticated caller can mutate any item.
